summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Debt Management feature. All backend APIs working correctly. Frontend pages (Debts, Customers, Sales) properly integrated. Fixed minor UX issue where debt payment option was visible to non-admin users.

backend_api_tests: GET /api/debts/dashboard - returns debt statistics (total_receivables, total_customers_with_debt, overdue_amount, collected_this_month)
GET /api/debts/customers-summary - returns debt summary per customer with available_credit calculation
GET /api/debts/customers-summary?only_with_debt=true - filters to only customers with debt
GET /api/debts/customer/{customer_id}/available-credit - returns credit info (max_debt_limit, current_debt, available_credit, can_use_credit)
GET /api/debts - returns list of all debts with proper structure
POST /api/sales with debt requires customer - returns 400 without customer
POST /api/sales with debt requires admin - returns 403 for non-admin users
POST /api/sales with debt checks credit limit - returns 400 for customer without credit
GET /api/payment-methods includes 'debt' with admin_only=true and requires_customer=true
GET /api/customers returns max_debt_limit and current_debt fields
frontend_tests: Debts page (/debts) accessible to admin with 3 tabs (Tableau de bord, Clients endettés, Historique)
Debts page shows 4 stats cards (Total Créances, Clients Endettés, En Retard, Encaissé ce Mois)
Clients endettés tab shows table with columns (Client, Dette Actuelle, Seuil Max, Utilisation, Nb Dettes, Actions)
Historique tab shows table with columns (Date, Client, Montant, Mode, Par)
Customers page shows 'Crédit dispo:' for each customer with credit limit
Customer form has 'Seuil de crédit maximum' field with hint '0 = pas de crédit autorisé'
Sales page payment dropdown includes 'Dette (Crédit)' option for admin
Sales page shows warning 'Veuillez sélectionner un client' when debt selected without customer
Sales page shows 'Crédit disponible: X GNF' when customer with credit selected
Debts link hidden from sidebar for non-admin users (pharmacien)
Dette payment option hidden from dropdown for non-admin users (after fix)

critical_code_review_comments: Debt management feature well-implemented with proper separation of concerns
Backend correctly validates: customer required, admin role required, credit limit check
Frontend properly displays credit info and warnings for debt sales
Fixed: Payment method dropdown now filters admin_only methods based on user role
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/pages/Sales.js - Added filter for admin_only payment methods in dropdown

success_rate.backend: 100% (15 passed, 1 skipped - no pending debts for payment test)

seed_data_creation: No seed data created - used existing customers with credit limits (Mamadou Camara 500k, Fatoumata Barry 1M, Aissatou Sow 750k, etc.)
